meta.title: Buy PPL
meta.description: PPL is sold on a public price curve: it starts at $0.005 and rises with every purchase. The $0.25 ceiling is only reached if all 100M sale PPL sell, at about $6,262,744 raised. The sale runs until sold out or 24 months; sell-back lots have a 30-day hold.

whyPriceRises.title: Why the price rises
whyPriceRises.noManualLead: The PEOPLE team does not set or raise the price. A public formula in the sale smart contract sets it automatically: each purchase moves the price along the bonding curve. Nobody can change the price manually.
whyPriceRises.mechanism: Same formula-based pricing as Uniswap, Bancor (pioneer, 2017), pump.fun, and Virtuals Protocol on Base: here price = f(tokens sold), transparent and verifiable on chain.
whyPriceRises.example: From the published curve parameters: {startPrice} per PPL at the start, {midPrice} after {midSold} PPL sold (~{midRaised} raised), and {endPrice} at the end of the curve ({endRaised} raised).
whyPriceRises.reserve: Funds from purchases stay in the sale reserve on Base and are used to buy PPL back from holders — sell-back for verified users after a 30-day hold, subject to daily limits.
whyPriceRises.chartAria: PPL sale bonding curve: price versus PPL sold

curve.title: One curve, visible to everyone
curve.lead: The price is not set by hand. price = {start} × e^(k·x), where x is millions of PPL sold and k = ln(50)/100. Every figure below is computed from that formula.
curve.ceilingNote: The {ceiling} ceiling is only reached if all {supply} PPL sell, at {endRaise} raised. Otherwise the sale ends after 24 months.
curve.capScope: The {ceiling} cap applies during the curve sale only. After the sale ends, the price in the pool is set by the free market — no upper limit and no lower limit.

whatYouGet.title: What a purchase actually gives you

items.title: PPL on your address, immediately
items.body: Your PPL is recorded to your address in the sale contract on Base the moment you buy and is credited as native PPL on the PEOPLE network at genesis. There is no lock-up on purchased PPL beyond the 30-day sell-back hold.

items.title: Sell-back from the reserve
items.body: Sell-back from the reserve is for verified people only: each purchase lot must be held 30 days before it can be sold back; the sell-back price is the curve price at the moment of exit; global cap 2% of the reserve per day; personal cap $2,000 per person per day; fee 1.5% (3% when total sell-backs that day exceed 1% of the reserve); sell-back closes when the sale ends; payouts in USDC on Base.

items.title: Transfers open with the full network launch
items.body: Sending PPL to other people and trading in the pool start at full mainnet: {verified} verified participants and the published multisig gate apply to PPL transfers, not to the sale opening.

items.title: When the sale ends
items.body: {liquidityShare} of the raise plus PPL at the last curve price seed a public pool whose LP tokens are locked for {lock} months. The other {multisigShare} goes to the project multisig, with public reporting on every spend.

timeline.title: From the curve to a free market

steps.title: The curve
steps.body: {supply} PPL on a public curve from {start} up to a {ceiling} ceiling. Buy and sell on the curve from the day the sale opens; each sell-back lot has a 30-day hold. The sale runs until sold out or for {saleMonths} months, whichever comes first; there are no extensions.

steps.title: When the sale ends
steps.body: The curve stops when all PPL sell or after {saleMonths} months, whichever comes first. {liquidityShare} of the raise plus PPL at the final curve price go into a public DEX pool at exactly that price, with no jump. LP locked for {lock} months. {multisigShare} to the multisig with public reporting.

steps.title: Full mainnet
steps.body: PPL transfers between wallets and pool trading open at full mainnet: {verified} verified participants, and no later than {months} months. The gate applies to PPL transfers, not to the day the sale opens.

steps.title: If the curve does not sell out
steps.body: The term is fixed and will not be extended. Whatever was raised still gets the same {liquidityShare}/{multisigShare} split, every unsold PPL goes to the Community Pool, and there are no refunds outside sell-back. Until the sale ends, unsold PPL is held in the project multisig and the team does not touch it.

faq.title: Questions, answered

items.q: How long does the sale run?
items.a: Until all PPL is sold or for {saleMonths} months, whichever comes first. The term is fixed and will not be extended. After it ends, unsold PPL goes to the Community Pool; there are no refunds outside sell-back. Until then, unsold PPL is held in the project multisig and the team does not touch it.

Sell-back from the reserve is for verified people only: each purchase lot must be held 30 days before it can be sold back; the sell-back price is the curve price at the moment of exit; global cap 2% of the reserve per day; personal cap $2,000 per person per day; fee 1.5% (3% when total sell-backs that day exceed 1% of the reserve); sell-back closes when the sale ends; payouts in USDC on Base.

No. It applies while the curve is running. The {ceiling} cap is only reached at the end of the curve, with {endRaise} raised and {endPrice} per PPL. After the sale ends, the pool price is set by the free market, with no upper limit and no lower limit.

items.q: When can I send PPL to someone else?
items.a: At the full network launch: {verified} verified participants, and no later than {months} months. Buying and selling on the curve works from day one.

faq.pumpTitle: What goes wrong on curves without a ceiling
faq.pumpLead: Bonding curves became popular through launchpads like pump.fun. These are their known problems, and what we do instead.

pumpRows.what: The price runs up toward a hard ceiling, and buyers late in the sale pay far more than the first ones.
pumpRows.ours: A hard {ceiling} ceiling. The curve reaches it only when all PPL sell, at {endRaise} raised — around {endPrice}.

pumpRows.what: Scripts buy in the first seconds from many wallets, then sell to real people.
pumpRows.ours: Up to {perBuy} per purchase, {perDay} per person per day, and a {cooldown}-second pause between trades. If bots show up, the multisig can switch on a verified-only mode.

pumpRows.what: Large holders sell everything at once and crash the price.
pumpRows.ours: Per-person limits stop anyone building a large position. The {fee} sell fee goes to PPL buyback, and pool liquidity is locked for {lock} months.

pumpRows.what: A trade fills at a price much worse than the one you were shown.
pumpRows.ours: Slippage protection on every trade: a minimum received, or the transaction is cancelled.

pumpRows.what: The token is pushed onto exchanges in the middle of the sale.
pumpRows.ours: No listings during the sale. DEX trading only after the sale ends.
